subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Circling back on my note about driving completed, paid orders for your platform across UK mobile and desktop web. The one point worth repeating: we run on a cost-per-sale basis, so you pay per completed order rather than per click, and a refunded or cancelled basket reverses before it is billed, with click and order traffic fraud-screened before attribution. We have held that pattern at 3,000 completed orders a day in UK food delivery. If it helps, I can share the cuisine and postcode order view for your zones. Worth a short look?
register_notes: Stage 1 EN food_and_delivery CPS: references prior outreach in S1; restates single proof (cost-per-sale completed-order basis + cancellation reversal + pre-attribution fraud screening); one illustrative figure (3,000 completed orders/day, flagged); soft CTA, 1 question mark; native UK business English; no sign-off; no X-not-Y.
